style: Warm cinematic 35mm look, soft natural window light and amber lantern pools, shallow depth of field, slow patient camera moves, gentle ambient sound of wind, cedar creaks and incense crackle, no music but a distant bamboo flute.

entities.name: Master Bramble
entities.descriptor: a very old, broad, heavy green frog teacher with deep amber half-closed eyes, sitting perfectly still in meditation

entities.name: Pip
entities.descriptor: a small bright-green tree frog student with enormous curious eyes, fidgety, always peeking during silent practice

entities.name: The Cedar Hall
entities.descriptor: a high mountain meditation hall of honey-coloured cedar with exposed beams, iron lanterns on chains, sheer cream curtains, three tall arched windows facing a blue mountain, rows of slate-blue mats on a polished wooden floor, a brass incense bowl
